headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 10, 2026, the portfolio set has achieved an average return of 17.77%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark, which returned 11.32%. This results in an average alpha of 6.45%, indicating that the portfolios are not only rising in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 42.36%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', still managed a return of 10.41%. This outperformance relative to SPY is particularly notable during times of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience in the portfolio's strategy. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
